summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of RouteMail Backup & Restore feature. 28/28 backend pytest cases pass (5 exports, credential gating, CSV exports, ZIP structure, preview, auth, bad ZIP / missing-metadata / future-schema, conflict modes copy/skip/replace, cross-user isolation, CSV imports). Frontend e2e validates login -> sidebar entry -> /backup page rendering -> all 5 module cards -> Export JSON download (verified via Content-Disposition: attachment) -> Email Lists CSV import dialog -> Full Restore dialog (upload ZIP -> preview summary -> ack -> Restore enabled).

issues: CRA dev-mode 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay appears with harmless 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.' warnings (likely Radix UI dialogs). Not a real bug but intercepts user clicks until dismissed. Recommend either suppressing in development overlay config or wrapping ResizeObserver to debounce. Does not affect prod build.

action_items: (Low priority) Suppress noisy ResizeObserver warning in CRA dev overlay to improve dev UX. Not a functional bug; production build unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: backup_routes.py is well-structured: schema_version constant, _sanitize_account() strips both smtp_password and smtp_password_encrypted by default - verified plain password fields never leak even with include_credentials=true (only smtp_password_encrypted is exposed).
Conflict modes correctly enforce: copy renames to '(Imported)' with new IDs, skip increments counts.skipped with zero inserts, replace keeps same ID and forces status=draft/pending_verification.
Cross-user isolation enforced via user_id filter on every collection query - dhruv's exports correctly return only his own data.
Validation: bad-ZIP, missing metadata.json, schema_version > 1, and invalid conflict value all return 400 with clear messages.
Imported email_accounts use plus-addressing (+imported-XXXX) to avoid uniqueness collisions - clever workaround.
Frontend BackupRestore.jsx has all required data-testid hooks and proper loading/disabled states (Restore button correctly disabled until both file + ack present).
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=routemail-{module}-YYYYMMDD.json header verified on all exports - downloads correctly via blob in axios.
MINOR: 'CSV format reveals List name input' inside Email Lists import - confirmed working but the select option uses default Radix overlay; works fine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows: login, navigation, sidebar, page render, module cards, export download with Content-Disposition, CSV import dialog flow, full-restore dialog preview + ack + button enablement)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_backup_restore.py is a regression suite for backup/restore. It depends on drip.tester having >=1 campaign/drip/account/list/dne to exercise copy/skip/replace modes. The list-endpoints in this app are /api/lists and /api/dne-lists (NOT /api/email-lists or /api/dne/lists) - keep this in mind when writing related tests. Use page.evaluate fetch trick for ZIP upload in Playwright since multipart File construction via Playwright's set_input_files needs a real path; the in-page DataTransfer approach worked reliably.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. All 22 review-request bullets passed: 5 export shapes, credential opt-in/out, CSV exports, ZIP structure, preview, copy/skip/replace, cross-user isolation, 401 unauthenticated, bad ZIP / missing metadata / schema mismatch (400), CSV imports (email-lists + dne-lists with is_global=False enforced), bad conflict value (400), frontend sidebar + page + module cards + downloads + CSV format reveal + full restore dialog preview/ack/enable.
